name: skardi-query-log
description: Turn questions the user keeps asking into Skardi pipelines. Reads the query audit log written by `skardi-server --query-audit-db` (read-only), spots ad-hoc SQL that repeats, and installs the pipeline itself — writing the YAML, restarting, probing health, and rolling back if the server does not come up. Requires Skardi newer than v0.5.0.
